nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What type of soil was discovered in the Amazon basin and what are its characteristics?
nodes.answer: The soil discovered in the Amazon basin is a specific type of fertile, very dark, carbon-rich soil that contains greater nutrient content and organic carbon content than surrounding soils.

nodes.question: In which publication and year can the research on N2 emissions be found?
nodes.answer: The research on N2 emissions can be found in "Biology and Fertility of Soils" published in 2025.
